# Simply by Daniel

> Simply by Daniel is a brand and website design practice in Minnesota, run by Daniel. It makes logos, brand kits and websites for companies that want one clear identity. Tagline: "Brands, made simply."

## What Simply does
- Logos
- Brand kits: colours, type and usage rules
- Websites

## Process
Six steps: Words, Research, Sketch, Digital design, Finish, System. A website follows when it is part of the project.
